title: Do not start Hunter x Hunter with the 1999 one
caption: Do not start Hunter x Hunter with the 1999 one. Watch the 2011 version. Same story. The one people mean.

scenes.text:
Do not start
Hunter x Hunter
with the 1999 one.
scenes.voice: Do not start Hunter x Hunter with the 1999 one.
Same story. Cleaner fights. It is the one people mean when they say start it.

scenes.text:
The Hunter Exam
is the door.
scenes.voice: The Hunter Exam is the door. That is the hook.

scenes.text:
Then it stops
being an adventure.
scenes.voice: Then the show stops being an adventure.

scenes.text:
That is the
Chimera Ant arc.
scenes.voice: That is the Chimera Ant arc. That is where most people get ruined for other shonen.
Save this. Start 2011 tonight. Watch it again for the version.
